id: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs (1937)
title: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
tagline: Seven dwarfs. One pie. No apples.
about: A princess hides from her jealous stepmother in a cottage with seven dwarfs.
cue: Serve dessert when Snow White bakes her pie for Grumpy.
faces: Tea at home, in the front room
SNOW WHITE AND THE SEVEN DWARFS
"Bashful, please wash your hands. Grumpy, you too. The stew is ready, and I made extra for all of you. Now sit down."
Luncheon from noon. Afternoon tea 3 till 5.
Mind the cake trolley on your way in.
Cheddar, gouda and brie cubes on toothpicks with red and green grapes.
Walnuts, hazelnuts and almonds roasted with honey and rosemary.
Chicken thighs, leeks and potatoes simmered with thyme.
Cottage herb roast chicken and veg
The dwarfs' cottage in the woods.
Gooseberries cooked with sugar under a pastry lid.
Shiny red apple and cinnamon punch
Apple juice simmered with cinnamon, cloves and orange peel, served chilled.
